title: I turned my full suite algorithmic trading platform into a Grok bot
author: NextgenAITrading
selftext:
Last week, I posted my [Public Portfolio Challenge](https://nexustrade.io/blog/series/public-portfolio-challenge) and people were shocked to see an actual working algorithmic trading platform trading real money. To make sharing and copying it easier, not only did I update my blog...

But I created a Grok bot. 

The Grok bot allows you to run the same set of tools to create the portfolios that are **trading over $40,000 of my REAL actual money** (not backtesting, not paper-trading). Click it, copy the bot, and optionally point it the [Public Portfolio Challenge open-source GitHub repo. ](https://github.com/austin-starks/public-portfolio-challenge)

Try it out and let me know what you think!

P.S., if you're anti-Elon, I also have a [developer's API](https://nexustrade.io/developers#connect) that has access to the MCP server, API, and SDK. But, I thought "Grok bot" might make it more accessible to the average person. I am NOT an Elon Musk-stan 💀, please don't crucify me.

comments.author: leroylabs
comments.body: When someone copies the Grok bot and points it at the Public Portfolio Challenge repo, which parts of your setup come with it: strategy definitions, current portfolio state, or only tool instructions? That distinction matters if the showcased portfolios are trading $40,000 live. I’d include a capability manifest showing whether each Grok, MCP, API, or SDK action can research, create a plan, modify a portfolio, or submit an order, plus where confirmation is required. The graphic says “Review the plan before portfolio changes or…” but the rest of that safety boundary is cut off.

replies.author: NextgenAITrading
replies.body: It comes with the strategy definitions and how to create a strategy yourself. Grok bot walks you though the process step-by-step. Don't worry; Grok is physically unable to actually execute a trade on your behalf.

comments.author: investigatormaker
comments.body:
The real-money Public Portfolio Challenge is the strongest hook here, but "Try it out" leaves a first-time reader guessing what to type. One example prompt in the post, plus what the bot returned for it, would show off the tools in ten seconds. The developer API with the MCP server reaches a different audience, so I'd give it its own post rather than a P.S.

comments.author: koryuken
comments.body: The live record looks like what the rules suggest. It made money in the May–July tech run, then gave back most of it as momentum faded. That's the main risk of a long-only book in long-dated calls with no hedge. The scoreboard in his repo (+10.8% as of 10-12) is already out of date; the account is at +7.0% as of 10-16.

replies.author: NextgenAITrading
replies.body: Unfortunately. But I'm still optimistic on tech. For holding call options, it's not doing TOO bad.
